summary.intent: Resolve merge conflicts on PRs in the orin-dx/caliper repo, identified via entire.com trail change links (first trail 211/change 159, then trail 172/changes 120 and 121).
summary.outcome: PR #362 (trail 211, change 159) was found to be the only PR conflicting with main and a worker was dispatched to resolve it, but its result was not yet seen. For the second request (trail 172 changes 120/121), the assistant had only started mapping the changes to PRs and checking conflicts.

repo: PR #362 was previously based on #342; since #342 merged, main is now its base, which caused the conflict.

When resolving #362, the branch's own additions (schema-version readers, OpaqueReason list, trycmd snapshot, tests, changeset) are kept, while main's version is taken where the branch only carried an older copy of #342's detected-by work.
Full pre-push gate for conflict resolution includes the lint gate plus Rust, Python and oracle tests; pushes are done without force.
Dependabot #367 fix (commit 3524f269) replaces `_file` with `editor` and `program` in provider.ts; it passes lint gate, storybook (62), vite-plugin (58), tsc and test-integration locally.
@napi-rs/cli 3.10.9 does not change the target-triple parsing (parseTriple) relied on by the glibc fix versus 3.10.8.
workflow: Entire trail/change URLs must be mapped to PR numbers before checking for conflicts.
Parallel workers are used per PR for conflict resolution, with each worker required to report every non-review check by name and mark unfinished ones as 'pending'.
When a PR's base branch has merged, rebase/retarget onto main before resolving conflicts.

friction: Dependabot #367's new CI run was queued about 20 minutes with no jobs started, leaving all 16 checks pending and the fix unconfirmed.
Verification of @napi-rs/cli 3.10.9 was incomplete: parseTriple was diffed between versions but createArtifactDestinationName was only read in 3.10.9, not diffed.
open_items: Confirm the #362 worker's result (conflict resolution, checks, push).
Re-check Dependabot #367 CI once the queue moves.
Await results of the #335/#345 and #324/#359 workers.
Determine which PRs trail 172 changes 120 and 121 map to and whether they still conflict.
